name: Western Chalukya Empire
short_desc: A restored Chalukya dynasty rules the western Deccan from its capital at Kalyani.
date_note: Uses the source’s sovereign phase, 973–1184; vassal origins date to 957, and a final restoration attempt continued to 1189.
